name: Alacritty
tagline: A minimal, fast terminal without tabs or splits
description: A deliberately small GPU-accelerated terminal emulator. It draws text quickly and leaves tabs, splits and session management to your window manager or a multiplexer such as tmux.

maturity.rationale: Stable, conservative and widely packaged since 2017. It rarely surprises.

strengths: Starts instantly and stays out of the way
A simple TOML configuration file with live reload
Vi mode, search and clickable regex hints are built in
Available everywhere, including Windows and the BSDs
weaknesses: No tabs or splits: the project considers that the job of a window manager or multiplexer

featureNotes.tabs-splits: By design; pair it with tmux or Zellij
